beats.label: S1 · Jimmy goes rogue
beats.text: Widowed therapist Jimmy starts hijacking his patients' lives — pushing Grace to leave her abusive husband Donny, and moving combat vet Sean into his guest house.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Jimmy's ethics violation and introduces Grace and Sean, the two patients who drive S1 and stay through S2.

beats.label: S1 · Paul steps in
beats.text: Sean grows close to Jimmy's neglected teen daughter Alice, while Jimmy's mentor Paul quietly parents her through her grief and cuts Jimmy off over his ethics breaches.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up S2's therapy handoff of Sean to Paul and Paul's ongoing role as Alice's second parent.

beats.label: S1 · Paul's diagnosis
beats.text: Paul discloses his Parkinson's, first to his lawyer Brian and eventually to his estranged daughter Meg, quietly reshaping how much he can rely on the people around him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Paul's disease is the ticking clock behind his entire S2 arc with Julie, Meg, and his practice.

beats.label: S1 · Jimmy and Gaby
beats.text: At a party at his house, a drunk Jimmy sleeps with his colleague Gaby; they call it a one-off, then fall into bed again the night of Nico's art exhibition.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Jimmy-Gaby affair is the relationship S2 opens on and untangles across its first half.

beats.label: S1 · Liz finds a lane
beats.text: Neighbour Liz — who has been raising Alice since Tia died — clashes with Jimmy over that role, then agrees to bankroll Sean's fledgling catering business.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Liz's business entanglement with Sean and her identity as caretaker, both central to her S2 unraveling.

beats.label: S1 · Jimmy comes back
beats.text: Jimmy finally lets Alice into his grief, unpacks Tia's things with her, and gives a raw speech at Brian's wedding that makes Gaby realise her feelings for him are real.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The father-daughter thaw and Gaby's dawning feelings are the emotional starting points S2 picks up from.

beats.label: S1 · Grace shoves Donny
beats.text: On a hike, Grace snaps at Donny's cruelty and shoves him off a cliff, acting on Jimmy's advice never to accept his abuse again.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the S1→S2 cliffhanger; Grace's arrest is the first thing S2 has to deal with.

cliffhanger.text: Grace has just pushed her abusive husband Donny off a cliff, acting on Jimmy's advice never to accept his abuse again. On the same day, Gaby has quietly realised her feelings for Jimmy — the man she has twice fallen into bed with — are real.
questions: Is Donny dead, and will Grace face criminal consequences for the push?
Will Jimmy's role in Grace's decision come out and cost him his career?
Can Gaby and Jimmy stay just friends, or will she act on what she now feels?

characters.name: Jimmy Laird
characters.line: Grieving therapist and dad who spent the year meddling in his patients' lives to distract from Tia's death; barely holding his household together, and sleeping with his colleague.

characters.name: Alice Laird
characters.line: Jimmy's teenage daughter, at last starting to reconnect with her father after a year of being effectively parented by the neighbours.

characters.name: Paul Rhoades
characters.line: Jimmy's senior colleague and mentor; newly diagnosed with Parkinson's, dating his doctor Julie, and functioning as Alice's surrogate parent.

characters.name: Gaby Evans
characters.line: The third therapist in the practice, recently divorced from Nico; has slept with Jimmy twice and just realised she has real feelings for him.

characters.name: Sean Aiken
characters.line: A young combat vet with PTSD, kicked out by his father; now Jimmy's patient, roommate, and business partner with Liz on a fledgling catering venture.

characters.name: Liz
characters.line: Jimmy's next-door neighbour who half-raised Alice after Tia died; now empty-nesting and financing Sean's catering business.

characters.name: Brian
characters.line: Jimmy's best friend, an estate lawyer, freshly married to his longtime boyfriend Charlie after Jimmy officiated the wedding.

characters.name: Grace
characters.line: Jimmy's former patient; finally left her abusive husband at Jimmy's urging, went back to him, and has just shoved him off a cliff during a hike.

characters.name: Donny
characters.line: Grace's abusive husband, who Grace has just pushed off a cliff after Jimmy spent months telling her not to accept his cruelty.

characters.name: Tia Laird
characters.line: Jimmy's wife, killed before the series in a car accident; her absence drives every relationship in the family.

beats.label: S2 · Grace bows out
beats.text: Grace is arrested for the cliff push but her charges are dropped; Brian talks her into leaving Donny for good and moving to Vancouver with her sister.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the S1 cliffhanger cleanly so S2 can pivot to Louis; Grace is not the story the reader is walking back into.

beats.label: S2 · Louis arrives
beats.text: Louis, the drunk driver who killed Tia, walks into Jimmy's office to apologise; Jimmy throws him out, but Alice quietly tracks Louis down to confront him herself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Louis is the engine of the whole season and the source of the S2 cliffhanger.

beats.label: S2 · Paul's clock
beats.text: Paul takes on Sean as a patient and forces Jimmy out of that role; his Parkinson's worsens as Julie moves in, and his doctor gives him under a year of working meds.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets a hard countdown on Paul's practice and cements Julie as a live-in partner, both of which the reader carries forward.

beats.label: S2 · Gaby out, Sofi in
beats.text: Gaby ends the fling with Jimmy and starts dating Derek's friend Derrick #2, while Jimmy meets divorced mother Sofi buying Alice a car for her 18th birthday.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets Jimmy's romantic slate and introduces both his new interest and Gaby's new relationship.

beats.label: S2 · Liz kisses Mac
beats.text: Empty-nester Liz drifts back to her ex Mac and kisses him; she confesses to Derek, who briefly leaves before forgiving her and pulling her back into their family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: A marital rupture the reader must know was survived, and Liz's new post-crisis footing.

beats.label: S2 · Brian gets his baby
beats.text: Brian pushes past his own fear of fatherhood; he and Charlie are chosen by pregnant Ava after she initially picks another couple, and their child is on the way.
beats.whyLoadBearing: A permanent status change — Brian and Charlie are becoming parents — that reshapes what the family looks like going forward.

beats.label: S2 · Louis on the ledge
beats.text: Alice and Jimmy each forgive Louis, but Jimmy forbids him from the family. Alone and suicidal on Thanksgiving night, Louis reaches out — and Jimmy finds him at the train station.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The S2 cliffhanger every earlier Louis beat has been feeding into.

cliffhanger.text: Louis, the drunk driver who killed Tia, has been forgiven by Alice and by Jimmy — but Jimmy has ordered him to stay away from the family. Alone and suicidal on Thanksgiving night, Louis reached out to Alice, and it is Jimmy who finds him at the train station.
questions: Will Jimmy be able to talk Louis down?
If Louis lives, can he ever really stay out of the Lairds' lives now?
How much time does Paul have before his Parkinson's meds stop working, and what will that do to his practice and to Julie?

characters.name: Jimmy Laird
characters.line: No longer meddling in patients' lives; single again after ending the fling with Gaby, tentatively drawn to Sofi, and racing to a train station to stop the man who killed his wife from killing himself.

characters.name: Alice Laird
characters.line: Now 18, off therapy, more independent; has forgiven Louis and is on steadier ground with her father, though still learning how to trust him.

characters.name: Paul Rhoades
characters.line: Jimmy's mentor; his Parkinson's is advancing, Julie has moved in, and his doctor has told him he has under a year before his medication stops working.

characters.name: Louis
characters.line: The drunk driver who killed Tia; forgiven by Alice and Jimmy, banned by Jimmy from any further contact, and alone and suicidal at a train station on Thanksgiving.

characters.name: Gaby Evans
characters.line: Fellow therapist; walked away from the fling with Jimmy and started dating Derek's friend Derrick #2, though he's asked her to work on herself before they continue.

characters.name: Sean Aiken
characters.line: Reconciled with his father Tim, still living in Jimmy's guest house, and now sharing his food truck business with both Tim and Liz.

characters.name: Liz
characters.line: Kissed her ex Mac while empty-nesting, confessed to Derek, and has found a new sense of purpose lined up as part-time nanny to Brian and Charlie's coming baby.

characters.name: Brian
characters.line: Jimmy's best friend, expecting his and Charlie's first child via Ava after nearly missing out — having genuinely made peace with fatherhood.

characters.name: Julie
characters.line: Paul's romantic partner, who moved in with him after her husband died.
